result.question: How much did Nvidia spend on research and development in its latest fiscal year (FY2026)?
result.answer: NVIDIA spent $18,497 million (approximately $18.5 billion) on research and development in fiscal year 2026 (the year ended January 25, 2026), as reported in its Consolidated Statements of Income in the 10-K filing [0001045810-26-000021:item-15-p005]. This is corroborated by the XBRL-tagged fact for us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense, which records $18,497,000,000 USD for the period ending 2026-01-25 [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense:2026-01-25]. R&D represented 8.6% of revenue in FY2026 [0001045810-26-000021:item-7-p007].
